versions.changelog:
No functional changes in this release.

- Documentation updated with a contact email for user feedback.
- No code or behavioral changes detected.
Added Live Demo link — try the skill at inspiredhub.ai/demo before installing

- Expanded documentation: SKILL.md now includes a richer overview, key artists, specific defining works, color palette, and application rules for writing, UI design, and branding.
- Added detailed evaluation criteria, including must-have and must-avoid features and a confidence threshold.
- All auxiliary files (README.md, _meta.json, skill.json) have been removed, consolidating information into SKILL.md only.
Fix README: remove trailing period after markdown link to prevent /taste). malformed URL parsing
Updated skill count from 76+ to 86 to reflect latest InspiredHub additions (40 literary skills).

Initial release of the taste-impressionism skill

- Introduces a distilled Impressionism aesthetic for AI agents, based on analysis of 4,900 works.
- Provides style tokens and anti-tokens to guide creation or evaluation of visual content.
- Includes practical usage examples for applying Impressionist principles.
- Outlines features available in the full version, including color palettes, application rules, and evaluation criteria.
- Offers links to unlock the full skill and explore additional aesthetic movements.
